name: Kōshi (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōshi city emblem in orange, green and blue: an orange disc with green leaves above a blue stylised swoosh.
history: Municipal flag of Kōshi, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 February 2006.

features.role: Kōshi city emblem — an orange disc with green leaves above a blue stylised swoosh
